events.what_it_is: A two-day public fragrance pop-up for Estée Lauder's Glimmer Eau de Parfum with fragrance discovery, photo moments, street treats and promotional gifts.
events.what_is_free: Admission is free. Current event coverage advertises treats, photo moments and a chance to receive Estée Lauder product; specific gifts are not guaranteed to every visitor.
events.caveats: NYC Plugged and Average Socialite both describe the activation as open to the public and agree on the date-specific hours. No advance RSVP, ticket, or host-approval requirement is published in the verified listings. Promotional gifts are inventory-dependent.
events.practical_notes: Friday, September 11 from 12:30–7 PM and Saturday, September 12 from 11 AM–7 PM at 711 Greenwich Street.

events.event_name: DISCOVER SHIYENZE — Fashion Week Open Atelier
events.what_it_is: A three-day NYFW open atelier featuring Shiyenze Fashion, one-of-one designs, textiles, try-ons, shopping, designer conversation and Kenyan tea and wine.
events.what_is_free: Eventbrite lists admission as free with RSVP. Merchandise is available for purchase; no free product is promised to every attendee.
events.caveats: The organizer's Eventbrite listing says Free with RSVP and does not show an organizer-approval step. Registration is therefore treated as a normal free RSVP rather than approval-required access.
events.practical_notes: September 11 opening night 5–9 PM; September 12 open atelier 12–8 PM; September 13 atelier Sunday 12–6 PM.

events.what_it_is: A three-day Westman Atelier and ShopMy shopping pop-up featuring Gucci Westman's curated beauty, fashion and lifestyle picks plus Suprême Bio-Complex Liquid Foundation shade matching.
events.what_is_free: General pop-up access is free. The official Westman Atelier page advertises personalized shade matching and weekend surprises; merchandise remains retail unless otherwise stated.
events.caveats: NYC for FREE explicitly says the main pop-up is open to the public. The official Westman Atelier page separately links RSVP-only community programs such as the Friday GRWM, Saturday Shade & Spritz, and Sunday Walk Club; those special sessions should not be confused with general walk-in access.
events.practical_notes: General pop-up hours are September 11–13 from 11 AM–6 PM at 251 Elizabeth Street. Special community sessions have separate Eventbrite reservations on the official event page.

events.event_name: Ready, Set, Serve: A Tennis Fan Experience
events.address: The Shops at Skyview, 40-24 College Point Blvd, Flushing, NY 11354
events.what_it_is: A US Open fan experience at The Shops at Skyview with an immersive tennis photo booth, finals livestreams and a September 13 finale with a DJ, drinks and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: The host offers free tickets for the fan experience. The September 13 finale also advertises drinks and giveaways; quantities and specific items are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: The official host page links free Eventbrite tickets but does not state that a ticket is required for every portion of the public fan experience, so registration is treated as optional rather than approval-based. Giveaways and refreshments are specifically promoted for the September 13 finale.
events.practical_notes: September 11 at noon: Women's Doubles Final livestream; September 12 at noon: Men's Doubles Final and 4 PM: Women's Singles Final; September 13 at 2 PM: Men's Singles Final plus DJ, drinks and giveaways.
